title: docs(qa): re-point 19 checklist items and the cli-18-prerelease-db recipe in platform-core and cli
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9B6gStEwzhNnXcvLnqyJAFR)_

Fixes #33965
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台测试清单里 19 个条目和 1 个测试数据配方的文字(platform-core 10 个、cli 9 个，外加 cli-18-prerelease-db 配方)，每个条目 revision +1 并加一行 history。
- 为什么改:18.5.0 发版测试时跑手按原文走不通或读错的地方(锚卡 #33761 账本批次 C)，比如种子行数已从 138 变成 141、`os dev` 不再打印所有权拒绝而是自动升级、恢复脚本已会重新标日期，不改下一轮跑手会重复踩坑。
- 风险与回滚：只动 docs/qa 下两个 JSON 文本，不动产品代码;回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:cli.json 的 organization-ownership-ceremony acceptance[5].verify(判据从「计数相等」改为「旧行按 id 都在」，改动最实质)、cli.json 的 cli-18-prerelease-db 配方 knownGaps[4]、platform-core.json 的 activation-ledger-package-key-upgrade fixtures。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:platform-checklist`，预期最后一行 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 429 items`。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Batch C of the v18.5.0 close-out ledger (comment 6896511848 on #33761): the item-text re-point rows for `platform-core.json` and `cli.json`, with the `cli-18-prerelease-db` recipe. The card's 28 rows cover 19 items and the recipe; a row repeated across rounds is one edit. Each row was re-read at `origin/main` `0ac112fc` (PRs #33931 and #33929 in, and neither of their items touched) and the edit starts from the residue measured there, not the parked wording. No acceptance `clause` was weakened; three were corrected or extended (rows 4, 36, 199). Every edited item has `revision` +1 and one `history` row with ref `#PENDING-33965`, replaced by this PR's number in a second commit. The recipe carries no revision of its own, so its change is recorded in `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony`'s history, the item that scores on it (as revision 6 did). The area files were edited as text spans by a script and never re-serialised.

| Ledger row(s) | Item | Clause edited | What changed, and the reading behind it |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1, 183 | platform-core.seed-integrity | steps[1], steps[4] | Baseline 138 rows / invoice_line=7 → 141 / 10. Measured at `0ac112fc` by importing `ShowcaseSeedData` and summing each records array: 20 datasets, 141 rows, `showcase_invoice_line=10`; every other count unchanged. steps[4]'s banner example follows |
| 4, 185 | platform-core.v18-boot-refusals | acceptance[1].clause, .verify | The `--dev` spelling is printed by a standalone `os serve --dev` only. Under `os dev`, the refused `serve --dev` child sends the refusal to its parent over IPC and exits without printing it (`serve.ts` `announceOrganizationOwnershipRequired`), and `os dev` copies the DB and runs the ceremony itself (`dev.ts` `upgradeRefusedDevelopmentDatabase`, ADR-0131 D10). The pinned spelling is unchanged |
| 5 | cli-18-prerelease-db (recipe) | knownGaps[4], sequence[0].expect | "the restore does not re-date shards" is false: `cli-prerelease-fixture.ts` `restore` runs `dumpAsOf` → `fixture-as-of.ts` `shardRenamesAsOf`, renaming each rotation shard to the day before the run and printing a `re-dated shard` line per shard. QA run #33784 read `sys_activity__r20261114`, 66 rows, after the refused boot |
| 6, 186 (and 5's consequence) | cli.organization-ownership-ceremony | acceptance[5].verify | (1) "count after equals count before, less what moved" left no room for the rows this release's own second boot adds (invoice_line 5→10, sys_seed_landed_key 0→141, …); the oracle is now that every pre-existing id survives unless the report moved or deleted it, and a count may grow. (2) The sys_activity dropped-shard carve-out is retired, since the restore now re-dates the shard (row 5) |
| 8 | platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render | steps[3] | "open a user from Users" lands on a side panel (`?recordId=`); the step names the record URL `/_console/apps/setup/sys_user/record/ID`, where the `sys_user_detail` page carries the Preferences and Linked Accounts tabs |
| 36 | cli.migrate-duplicates-inventory | fixtures.requires[1], steps[1], acceptance[3].clause | (1) A NULL-organization row cannot be seeded: a table this release creates holds its tenant column NOT NULL (ADR-0131 D1, `sql-driver-column-creation.ts` `tenantColumn`); the duplicate is held by two organizations, which is the report's own question. (2) acceptance[3] said three pre-flight entries; `runtimeIndexProbes` lists seven from six migrations at `0ac112fc`, now named, with "read the count off the list" |
| 37 | cli.migrate-plan-apply-json | steps[8] | meta's dry run is `os migrate meta --from PREV --json`: `--from` is required without `--stored`, and a bare `--json` exits 1 `missing_from_major` (`meta.ts`) |
| 42 | cli.meta-package-flags-and-explain | steps[0] | The ViewItem body carries `viewKind: 'list'` and a `config`. Probed against the built `ViewItemSchema` at `0ac112fc`: without `viewKind` → "Invalid discriminator value. Expected 'list' \| 'form'"; the example body parses |
| 44, 194 | cli.dev-automigrate-policy | fixtures.knownGaps (new [2]) | The schemaMode half of acceptance[3] cannot be staged: a non-managed datasource is refused DDL at `assertSchemaMutable` before `reconcileAndWarnDrift` runs, so no boot reaches `autoOn` with another schemaMode; that half is read from source, as both rounds did |
| 47 | cli.lint-severity-exit-contract | fixtures.requires[0] | A camelCase object or field name is refused by `ObjectSchema` at load (probed: name pattern; "Invalid key in record" for a field key), so the error finding is the missing label; the i18n fold needs a second declared locale, since coverage is judged only against the stack's locales |
| 48, 199 | cli.doctor-deprecation-scan | steps[5], acceptance[3].clause | `os codemod --help` prints "Command codemod not found." (`@oclif/core` help module); the clause names the full scan boundary: `src/` only, names ending `.ts` minus `.test.ts`, so `.tsx` is skipped while `.spec.ts` and `.d.ts` are read, comments included (`scanDeprecatedPatterns`, `walkDir`) |
| 89 | cli.address-grammar-reserved-names | fixtures.requires[0] | Every hand-written scratch app declares `sharingModel`; without it the error-severity `security-owd-unset` finding stops validate/build before the namespace verdict |
| 90, 216 | cli.scaffold-console-first-paint | acceptance[3].verify | "a blank scaffold ships no app" is stale: the blank template ships `src/apps/main.app.ts` (app Main, a Notes entry), so the nav half is drivable; the action half stays a stated limit (`src/actions/index.ts` exports nothing) |
| 106, 218 | platform-core.activation-ledger-package-key-upgrade | fixtures.requires[0], requires[1] | Route (b) puts sys_metadata_activation's indexes back to 18.3.0's: drop the package-less index AND this release's `uniq_sys_metadata_activation_metadata_type_package_id_name`, recreate `uniq_sys_metadata_activation_metadata_type_name` on (metadata_type, name). Dropping the package-less index alone leaves no `replace_unique_index` to plan. requires[1] drops the recreated index too; the two-holder name names the `composeStacks` scratch app the runs used |
| 108 | platform-core.docs-portal-render | steps[3] | With one book, `AppDocsIndex` renders no listing and navigates into that book's reader (`AppDocsIndex.tsx`, `cards.length === 1`); the listing is read off the reader's book sidebar |
| 110 | platform-core.marketplace-console-honesty | fixtures.requires[2] | install-local's ledger follows `OS_HOME` (`OS_HOME/installed-packages`) and falls back to the working directory only without it (`local-manifest-source.ts` `resolveInstalledPackagesDir`); the text said OS_HOME does not redirect it. The scratch-copy rule stands |
| 122 | platform-core.protocol-18-handshake-and-stored-replay | steps[2], acceptance[3].verify | A `--artifact COPY` boots alone (`artifact-precedence.ts` `cwdConfigJoinsBoot`), so the showcase copy loses its code plugins and aborts after the conversion warns; the clause is read from those warns, and a serving boot needs an app with no code-plugin connector (`examples/app-todo`) |
| 123 | platform-core.stored-reference-package-backfill-upgrade | fixtures.requires[0] | The activation-ledger index plant is removed from this item's route (b): no row here is a ledger row and no clause reads that table. Route (a) not driven is run scope, not item text |
| 124, 125 | platform-core.notification-center | source[4], fixtures.requires[0] | `{"ids":[]}` is valid (`MarkNotificationsReadRequestSchema` takes any string array) and answers 200 readCount 0; a body without `ids` is the 400. The stock-seed-only fixture cannot drive acceptance[4] (one topic, nothing left for mark-all-read), so acceptance[4] needs the digest flood |
| 214 | platform-core.keyboard-shortcut-surface | steps[2] | The typed search term persists as `uf__search` across reloads in one browser context; clear it or use a fresh context per probe set |

Every row of the card was edited; none was already right at the base, and none moved to another carrier.

Forced test changes: none.

## Tests

No code changed. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` and the 16 gate families `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives for this diff were run on the merged head; each exited 0, and `--ran` reconciles 16 derived, 16 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. The commands and exit codes are in the os-dev-report comment on #33965.

## Acceptance notes

- `cli.lint-severity-exit-contract` acceptance[2] lists lint's `--json` keys without `strict`, `failing` and `conversions`, which the payload now carries (QA run #33829). That residue was in the QA record but not on this card's ledger rows, so it is not edited here.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/duplicates.ts`'s docblock still calls the pre-flight "four fixed platform indexes" (seven at this base). It is code, outside this card's file surface.
- Structural proof: the span editor parsed each area file before and after, applied the declared edits to the parsed `origin/main` document, and asserted the result equals the edited file's parse. Every non-edited item is value-equal; each edited item changes only the fields in the table plus `revision` and one appended `history` row.

## Verification

- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` → `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 429 items (421 active, 3 planned)`.
